verdict.rationale: Pulumi advertises secrets/config management as a first-class, unified part of its workflow ("Manage infrastructure, secrets, and configuration with a unified workflow across any cloud", "centralized secrets and governance") and details projects/stacks/config/secrets in its docs, plus Pulumi ESC can act as an OIDC provider for secure secret retrieval. However the evidence pack lacks concrete mechanics (e.g., `pulumi config set --secret`, encryption-at-rest details, log redaction specifics) or independent corroboration. Missing for 10: detailed docs on encrypted config storage/log-masking behavior, and hands-on/community validation that secrets never leak in practice.
